-- DEPTH CRAWL: 500 uncrawled pages, prioritized by intent
SELECT
  p.id as page_id,
  p.url,
  p.domain_id,
  d.domain,
  d.clinic_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(pricing|price|rates|fees|cost|trial|promo|package)' THEN 0
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(services|treatments|service|therapy)' THEN 1
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(contact|book|appointment|schedule|whatsapp)' THEN 2
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(about|team|our-story|clinic)' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END as priority_score
FROM wellness.pages p
JOIN wellness.domains d ON p.domain_id = d.id
WHERE 
  (p.last_crawled_at IS NULL OR p.last_crawled_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days')
  AND p.url IS NOT NULL AND p.url != ''
  AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%sitemap%'
  AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%.jpg' AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%.png'
  AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%.gif' AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%.pdf'
  AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%.css' AND p.url NOT ILIKE '%.js'
  AND d.domain IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(pricing|price|rates|fees|cost|trial|promo|package)' THEN 0
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(services|treatments|service|therapy)' THEN 1
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(contact|book|appointment|schedule|whatsapp)' THEN 2
    WHEN p.url ~* '/(about|team|our-story|clinic)' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  d.domain,
  p.last_crawled_at NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 500;

WITH fetch_log AS (
  INSERT INTO wellness.page_fetches (page_id, status_code, fetch_method, fetch_provider, bytes_received, quality_gate_failed)
  VALUES ($4::uuid, $5, 'http', 'n8n_http', $6, false)
  RETURNING page_id
),
content_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO wellness.page_content (page_id, content_hash, markdown, word_count, html_body)
  VALUES ($4::uuid, $3, $1, $7, $2)
  ON CONFLICT (page_id, content_hash) DO UPDATE SET
    markdown = EXCLUDED.markdown,
    html_body = EXCLUDED.html_body,
    word_count = EXCLUDED.word_count
  RETURNING page_id, content_hash
)
UPDATE wellness.pages 
SET last_crawled_at = NOW(), 
    last_http_status = $5, 
    content_hash = (SELECT substring(content_hash from 1 for 16) FROM content_upsert)
WHERE id = $4::uuid
RETURNING id as page_id;
